# Scent Stack

> Scent Stack sells digital fragrance workbooks, journals and planners (instant PDF download, printable and digital-friendly) to help people discover their taste, organise a perfume collection and wear fragrance with intention.

## Main pages
- [Shop](https://scentstack.store/shop): all digital fragrance products
- [Fragrance Discovery Workbook](https://scentstack.store/products/fragrance-discovery-workbook): 36-page guided workbook
- [Bundle](https://scentstack.store/bundle): the complete collection
- [Blog](https://scentstack.store/blog): practical fragrance guides and tips
- [FAQ](https://scentstack.store/faq): payment, delivery and refunds
- [Contact](https://scentstack.store/contact): customer support

## Notes
- Products are digital downloads delivered instantly by email after secure PayPal checkout.
